title: Cubic factor-invariant graphs of bialternating cycle quotient type
summary: In 2019, investigation of the so-called factor-invariant cubic graphs was initiated by Alspach, Khodadadpour and Kreher. For a cubic graph $Γ$ and a vertex-transitive subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{Aut}(Γ)$, a $2$-factor $\mathcal{C}$ of $Γ$ is said to be {\em $G$-invariant} if the set $\mathcal{C}$ is preserved by each element of $G$. Investigations of factor-invariant cubic graphs therefore contribute to the rapidly growing theory on cubic vertex-transitive graphs, providing a better insight into the structure of such graphs.
